author: ALM
body:
Hey all,

Today we are releasing a long-requested feature, Arrow Trails! These trails can be purchased from the gadget shop and can be enabled via your in game backpack by using the chest item or by typing /bp. 

You can also choose to hide all arrow trails by toggling the ShowArrowTrails setting.

Thanks,
The Avicus Development
